plan.notes: Source: official OSU catalog Computer Science, BS 'Finish in Four Plan of Study' (requirements for students matriculating in or before Academic Year 2026-2027), transcribed term-by-term from the official catalog degree-sheet PDF at https://okstate-preview.courseleaf.com/arts-sciences/computer-science/bs/bs.pdf and cross-verified against the OSU Registrar's official 2026-2027 Example Plan of Study PDF at https://registrar.okstate.edu/site-files/documents/computer-science-bs_eps-2026-2027.pdf. Catalog year: 2026-2027. Transcription method: direct line-by-line transcription of the published 'Example Plan of Study / Finish in Four Plan of Study' grid; no courses, credits, or sequences invented. The catalog labels this a suggested example that 'may be used as a guide and can be adjusted based on individual needs'; students must meet with an academic advisor prior to enrollment each semester. Degrees that follow this plan must be completed by the end of Summer 2032. Caveats: (1) UNIV 1111 First Year Seminar (1 credit) is listed as an Arts & Sciences College/Departmental requirement but does not appear in the suggested 120-hour grid — it is not added here because it is not in the term-by-term sequence. (2) General Education, Major/College/Elective, and Upper-Division CS Elective buckets are student-choice slots (8/9/6/6/9/6/6/3 credits as the grid shows). (3) The grid's 'or' course options (e.g., MATH 2163 / STAT 4033 / CS 3513) are modeled as choice slots listing the named options. (4) Prerequisites are not listed in the plan of study grid, so prereq arrays are empty.
